title: Key to Kindness: Reducing Toxicity In Online Discourse Through Proactive Content Moderation in a Mobile Keyboard

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing pre- and post-moderation message toxicity scores between male and female participants using independent sample t-tests to evaluate demographic differences in user behavior and intervention efficacy.

Qualitative analysis of semi-structured user interviews to explore perceptions of algorithmic transparency, fairness, and user concerns regarding potential political bias in the AI moderation system's decision-making.
